about_the_game:
🧪 Mixero

Create weapons from cards. Survive battles. Grow stronger with every attempt.

Mixero is a dynamic card-based action game where you build weapons directly from your deck and immediately test them in combat.

Each run is a short, intense loop:
build → craft weapon → enter battle → adapt → win or die.

⚔️ Features

🃏 Card-Based Weapon Crafting
Combine cards to create unique weapons - from fast and precise to chaotic and destructive.

⚡ Fast-Paced, Intense Combat
No downtime - the fight begins right after building. Every decision matters.

🔁 Progression & Replayability
Unlock new cards, improve your builds, and discover unexpected synergies. Each victory opens new possibilities.

🎯 Tactics + Improvisation
You’re not just building a deck - you adapt in real time to enemies and situations.

🧠 Why It’s Fun

  • Not just a deckbuilder - you use your creation immediately

  • Every build feels different

  • Minimal menus, maximum gameplay

  • Perfect for short play sessions
